args.sql:
-- The planet name is typically StarName + completter (e.g., '14 And b')
-- Let me build the query to find max transit depth for RV Method planets
-- Transit depth = (Rp / Rstar)^2
-- Rp in Jupiter radii, Rstar in solar radii
-- 1 R_jup = 0.1028 R_sun approximately

SELECT p.planetref, s.hostplname as star_name, 
       pp.radjup as planet_radius_jup,
       (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric as star_radius_solar,
       ROUND(CAST((pp.radjup * 0.1028 / (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric)^2 AS numeric), 6) as transit_depth
FROM planets p
JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
WHERE p.discmethod = 'RV Method'
AND pp.radjup IS NOT NULL
AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric > 0
ORDER BY transit_depth DESC
LIMIT 5;

       pp.radjup as planet_radius_jup,

       ROUND(CAST((pp.radjup / (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Radius_Value')::numeric)^2 AS numeric), 6) as transit_depth_no_conversion

JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink

SELECT s.hostplname || ' ' || p.completter AS planet_name,
       s.hostplname AS star_name,
       ROUND(CAST(pp.massjup / NULLIF((s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value')::numeric, '0') AS numeric), 6) AS mass_ratio
FROM planets p
JOIN physical_properties pp ON pp.objectlink = p.planetref
JOIN stars s ON s.stellarref = p.hostlink
WHERE p.discmethod = 'RV Method'
AND pp.massjup IS NOT NULL
AND (s.stellarprops->'physical'->>'Mass_Value') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY mass_ratio DESC
LIMIT 1;
